description: §23.2.4a — an inline value-returning foreign block in a tool function: its `in:{}` crossing is the sealed slice's parameter, the single-expression slice gets the injected `return`, and the settled value flows back into the scrml local (awaited at the boundary).
rationale: §23.2.4a: "The crossings are the parameters of the sealed slice and the block is a call of it with the same-named enclosing values; the `await` of that call is INJECTED by codegen at the boundary"; "Single-expression slice … Codegen injects the `return`".
